# Publish gate report

**Going out:** a review blog post with an affiliate link, to UK readers. No date was given.

**Checks run**
- **Claims:** "Easiest to pause" matches the policy ("subscribers can pause or cancel any time"). It's a first-person comparison from the reviewer's own experience, so I've left it. It's only fine if the writer really did try four subscriptions. "The tins are lovely" is opinion. No stats, guarantees, or health, green or urgency claims.
- **Regulated claims:** Nothing risky. It has no health, money, environmental or price claims.
- **House style:** The copy is short, plain and specific, with no AI tells. The policy has no voice section, so I couldn't score it against a reference.
- **Disclosure:** **Fails.** The only label is "(Affiliate link)", which sits at the very end of the post, after the reader has read the recommendation. UK rules (ASA/CAP and CMA) expect ads and affiliate relationships to be labelled clearly and upfront. A bracketed note at the end doesn't meet that.

**Fixed (suggested wording)**
- Add a plain-words disclosure at the start of the post, before the recommendation:

> *This post contains an affiliate link. If you buy through it, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.*

- Keep a short label next to the link too, e.g. "You can find it here (affiliate link)."

Suggested final copy:

> *This post contains an affiliate link. If you buy through it, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.*
>
> I've tried four tea subscriptions this year. Pebblebrook's was the easiest to pause, and the tins are lovely. You can find it here (affiliate link).

**Needs a decision**
1. **Was the product gifted or paid for?** If Pebblebrook sent free tea or any other benefit, that needs disclosing as well. My suggested answer is to add "Pebblebrook sent me this subscription" at the top if it applies.
2. **Can the writer confirm they tried four subscriptions this year?** If not, cut or soften that line.

**Approver:** The policy names no approver, so the sign-off is yours. Because the copy has to change, please approve the revised version above, not this draft. Approval of the earlier draft doesn't carry over.

**Verdict:** Don't publish yet. The upfront disclosure is missing.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "I've tried four tea subscriptions this year.", "type": "missing_disclosure"}], "publish": false}
```
